dialogue.text:
Noon with blooming cherry blossoms and splatters
of blood is the beginning of a magnificent battle.
Phew~ Finally left the library, things aren't so bad after all. According to the plan, I need to find the target in the eruption zone as soon as possible~
dialogue.speaker: Kiana

dialogue.text: I'm already here, I should avoid areas where zombies are densely packed to make progress. In that case, the most efficient route would be through the cherry blossom road at the center of Chiba Academy campus. Let's go!
dialogue.speaker: Kiana

dialogue.text: And yet... The once noisy academy is now quite quiet, it feels somewhat uncomfortable. Well, at least I don't have to pretend to be ladylike and accompany other girls to enjoy the flowers... At least there's something good in this situation~
dialogue.speaker: Kiana

dialogue.text: Whoa! Wait! Why am I suddenly getting sentimental!? I have important business!
dialogue.speaker: Kiana

dialogue.text: Whoa! My phone detected a Houkai source, gotta check~ There's a Houkai source 700 meters away for two hours...... Hmm~ Since it's the epicenter, the target must be here!
dialogue.speaker: Kiana

dialogue.text: Hehe~ Even though you left me this broken phone that can't make calls, this strange function is quite effective~ He didn't even think I'd use it to find him~
dialogue.speaker: Kiana

dialogue.text: Alright, continuing to move according to the plan!
dialogue.speaker: Kiana

dialogue.text: 50 meters to the target... Reached a place where the target can be seen.
dialogue.speaker: Kiana

dialogue.text: Must be around here, tsk~~ Quite a lot of zombies gathered here, even for this lady it'll be troublesome to deal with all of them...
dialogue.speaker: Kiana

dialogue.text: However, most zombies will move towards the source of sound. Using this weakness, I can effectively avoid some problems~
dialogue.speaker: Kiana

dialogue.text: Looks like the only way is to take a detour, first make noise here to attract their attention, then approach from the left flank.
dialogue.speaker: Kiana

dialogue.text: Whoa! What was that sound? I didn't even get to do anything! Oh... That's lightning? It was clearly sunny a while ago, so why...
dialogue.speaker: Kiana

dialogue.text: Agh! Oh no! I've been spotted!
dialogue.speaker: Kiana

dialogue.text: Fine then, looks like the only way is to force my way through!
dialogue.speaker: Kiana
